meta.title: Vice Coast palette theme
meta.description: Paints the interface from the GTA VI key art: frame violet, the sunset sweep and warm paper, in a night palette and a daylight postcard palette, with matching code and diff colours. Restore the stock palette or turn off the avatar frame in General settings.

row.title: Vice Coast theme
row.description: Colours taken from the GTA VI key art — violet night surfaces, the sunset sweep only on reasoning and the send key, semantics unchanged. Your avatar is matted off its blue background and stands on the same sunset.
